description: Defines the Duration class and helper objects for representing and manipulating time durations in Apache Spark Streaming.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: A class representing a time duration with various comparison and arithmetic methods.

methods.description: Checks if this Duration is less than another.
Checks if this Duration is less than or equal to another.
Checks if this Duration is greater than another.
Checks if this Duration is greater than or equal to another.
Adds two Durations.
Subtracts one Duration from another.
Multiplies a Duration by an integer.
Divides this Duration by another, returning a Double.

methods.name: less
methods.description: Java-friendly method to check if this Duration is less than another.

methods.name: lessEq
methods.description: Java-friendly method to check if this Duration is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: greater
methods.description: Java-friendly method to check if this Duration is greater than another.

methods.name: greaterEq
methods.description: Java-friendly method to check if this Duration is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: plus
methods.description: Java-friendly method to add another Duration.

methods.name: minus
methods.description: Java-friendly method to subtract another Duration.

methods.name: times
methods.description: Java-friendly method to multiply this Duration.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Java-friendly method to divide this Duration by another.

methods.name: isMultipleOf
methods.description: Checks if this Duration is a multiple of another Duration.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the smaller of two Durations.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the larger of two Durations.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if this Duration is zero.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: toFormattedString
methods.description: Returns the duration as a string.

methods.name: milliseconds
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the duration.
